items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: I had a Jewish friend that was up to -- my draft center was right around 146th Street... he used to tell me all the time... I'm going to try to look out after you.

ctx.x: Sure. It goes into their archives and it's -- it isn't something that anyone's going to be publishing.

Yeah. Well, look, I had a Jewish friend that was up to -- my draft center was right around 146th Street, see? And there was a box actually about as long as from here to over there. And he used to tell me all the time, he said, "You know, it would be a shame for them to put you in the Army," he says, "because I know you don't want to go and you're doind a lot of nice things here by playing with the band. You're playing Army things and so on," he says, "but I'm going to try to see -- I'm going to try to look out…
So I don't want to get anybody in trouble, you know. I don't know where he is now, really. But I was like 2-F. When
